planets.name: TOI-6255 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6255 with a 0.238-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-6255 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6255. Its orbit and size follow Dai et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
